services.name: Ventura County Fire Department (rescue ambulances, AMR/Gold Coast subcontract)
services.ownership: mixed: county fire subcontract to AMR
services.area: augments Camarillo, Santa Paula, Simi Valley, Thousand Oaks
services.evidence: Our seven exclusive operating areas remain contracted to our grandfathered providers, who also maintain a subcontract to Ventura County Fire Department for four rescue ambulances to augment ambulance coverage in the cities of Camarillo, Santa Paula, Simi Valley and Thousand Oaks.

06111.page_note: Seven exclusive ambulance areas cover the county: Gold Coast Ambulance runs areas 1 and 6, AMR runs areas 2-5 and 7, and Ventura County Fire rescue ambulances run under subcontract. A county bid for future providers is in preparation.
06111.second_source: https://emsa.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/sites/71/2026/01/Jan_26_AmbulanceEOAStatus.pdf (Jan 2026: ASA 1 & 6 Gold Coast Ambulance, ASA 2-5,7 AMR)
